author: LunarVanta
quote: My first ever review on Metacritic, because I just can't believe what I'm playing. I tried. I've spent hours in the game but I just feel like a mug. Like I'm being trolled by the Devs. It's so boring! I'm doing chores!!?? And the 30fps feels like 20. It's horrible. The last straw came after spending 10 minutes rearranging furniture with Cal. What a joke
